description: 《三国演义》讲述东汉末年群雄并起、英雄争霸的经典历史故事，包含刘备、关羽、张飞、曹操等重要人物。本系列适合通过 Watch、Listen and Read、Words 与 Quiz 进行分步学习。
updateNote: Episodes 1-3 use the earlier supplied source materials. Episodes 4-6 are built strictly from user-supplied English SRT subtitles. Episodes 7-8 use transcripts supplied by the site owner; Read preserves the supplied wording, and Words/Quiz are derived from those transcripts.
